'''Commissioner''' was a title used by the [[Galactic Gaming Commission]]. They were responsible for monitoring [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] activities and ensure that no insider trading occurred.

[[Dragomir Chlorus]] was a commissioner in the waning days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
